rule: This file records where shared English learning/runtime work should continue. It is not exam/source truth, private learner state, or a substitute for the Learning Contract, root LEARNING_ACCEPTANCE.md, and module owners.

objective_v1.first_learning_model: Objective Global Map -> task Core Blocks -> Skill Map -> stable high-value Deep Skill Content -> real clean Attempt
objective_v1.evidence_unit: question / blank / placement may remain internal evidence only
objective_v1.transfer_rule: later relevant fresh evidence outranks same-item correction; semantic closure remains Chat-mediated
current_blockers: Reading B must preserve and display the real Current task directions/form instead of projecting every set as a generic position task.
Reading B candidate assignment must preserve source constraints and support whole-map reconciliation without allowing invalid duplicate use when the directions forbid it.
Reading A local repair assets must not outrun whole-passage diagnosis; passage-level diagnosis chooses the repair scope first.
A task-specific transfer claim must not become TRANSFER_PENDING merely from diagnosis; explicit completed repair/re-execution evidence is required.
Transfer-check packets must carry enough current-task context for Chat to judge whether a pending claim was genuinely tested.
Claim import must be idempotent, reject unsupported closure/reopen updates, preserve pasted return text on persistence failure, and provide an executable conservative CLOSED -> REOPENED path.
reopen_only_when: a deliberate audit finds a concrete semantic, structural, coverage, Projection, Runtime, or Evidence defect
real learner use exposes repeatable friction or a missing stable high-value mental model
source/schema change breaks Current projection or validation

completed_shared_work: English capability architecture is frozen as Lexical / Reading / Translation / Writing plus task-specific trainers.
Objective Source, Knowledge, and Learning gates currently pass under root LEARNING_ACCEPTANCE.md; this does not imply Projection, Runtime, Evidence, or User Validation closure.

Objective static learning is complete-but-skippable: stable, frequent, generalizable teaching content remains in the canonical asset; learner proficiency changes navigation, not canonical content depth.

Reading A includes Question Demand, Decisive Evidence/Boundary, Option Proposition, Adjudication/Execution, Skill Map, and stable deeper content for cause/relation shift, attribution, local-to-global/example-to-claim, true-but-irrelevant, answer-switch discipline, and stop rules.

Cloze includes Slot Demand, five-layer Constraint Stack, Candidate Competition, context expansion/uncertainty execution, Skill Map, and stable deeper content for best-fit, collocation/semantic preference, near-synonym competition, construction authority, and discourse relation.

Reading B includes Discourse Skeleton, Position Demand, Candidate Role/Cohesion, Global Reconciliation, confidence ordering, provisional placement, coupled/cascade analysis, Skill Map, and stable deeper content for local-vs-global fit, coupled placement, and reference chains.
The shared /objective-learn/ page renders the canonical learning asset directly and provides fine-grained jump navigation while keeping direct practice available.
Objective Runtime v1 keeps learner-Chat review passage/set-level while question/blank/placement remains internal evidence; stable clean work is designed to pass without manufactured review debt.
Objective Evidence/Transfer v1 tracks repair threads and task-specific reusable claims rather than historical questions; Lexical and Reading roots route to their canonical ability owners.
Reading A legacy per-question WATCH transfer is no longer loaded in Current.
Translation has an independent Productive runtime and canonical learning owner at content/english/modules/translation/learning.md; it remains semantically separate from Objective.
Writing has a canonical static learning/runtime owner at content/english/modules/writing/learning.md; learner-facing web projection remains future work.

objective_tasks.inheritance: Objective cognition and first-learning content remain frozen unless evidence contradicts them. Current work is acceptance remediation only: repair concrete P/R/E blockers, then run module E2E. Do not call the lane complete or learner-validated until the corresponding gates actually pass.

translation.inheritance: Translation is an independent Productive lane. Preserve the first translation, diagnose the first meaningful failure, use the smallest useful repair, require learner reconstruction, and use later fresh transfer as stronger evidence than same-item polishing. Missing Current references remain explicit and must not be fabricated.

writing.inheritance: Writing is an independent Productive lane. Preserve first meaningful planning/content evidence and the first draft, diagnose the first meaningful failure, apply the smallest repair, require learner re-generation, and use later fresh Writing transfer as stronger evidence than same-prompt rewriting.
writing.current_owner_status: Static learning/runtime owner is ready; learner-facing web projection is intentionally not claimed complete.

next_action.instruction: Fix only the concrete acceptance blockers already found. Preserve S/K/L semantics. Then run current-main module E2E for clean PASS, wrong/uncertain -> whole-unit diagnosis -> completed repair/return, later relevant fresh transfer -> CLOSED, and later contradictory fresh evidence -> REOPENED. If S-E pass, relabel Objective as MODULE_READY_FOR_LEARNER_TEST with U still UNTESTED. Real learner use is required for any learner-validated claim.
remediation_order: Reading B task-form/direction projection and candidate constraints
Reading A whole-passage diagnosis before local repair
repair-completed evidence before new TRANSFER_PENDING claims
idempotent and evidence-bound return import including conservative reopen
isolated browser E2E acceptance on current main@HEAD
update Current acceptance language from actual evidence

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not expand Objective taxonomy or static Skill Content during this remediation unless a blocker proves a Knowledge gap.
Do not turn Reading A / Cloze / Reading B into question-by-question Chat review systems.
Do not restore per-question WATCH as the durable Reading A transfer object.
Do not close transfer claims from arbitrary N-pass counters.
Do not duplicate Lexical or Reading knowledge inside objective task stores.
Do not make First Learning a compulsory gate before direct practice or Continue.
Do not use learner proficiency as a reason to thin canonical static first-learning content; proficiency changes navigation and skip behavior instead.
Do not turn Skill Maps into compulsory curricula or teacher question-type taxonomies.
Do not expose formal answers or diagnostic assets before a clean attempt.
Do not merge Translation or Writing cognition into Objective merely for UI consistency.
Do not treat QA/build success as a substitute for S/K/L/P/R/E/U acceptance evidence.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update at each meaningful Objective acceptance transition and after each blocker class is resolved or disproven.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read root LEARNING_ACCEPTANCE.md, main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, content/english/LEARNING_CONTRACT.md, and only the Current owners needed for the acceptance task. Engineering acceptance state must not be mistaken for private learner progress.
